Hi Aditya,

Quick one from our security & privacy team — we noticed two new vendors have been added to Redwood's subprocessor roster this month (a logging provider and a metrics aggregator). Before we sign the updated DPA amendment, our legal team needs: 1) confirmation that those subprocessors will not cause onward transfers outside the EEA without explicit consent, and 2) copies of any completed DPIA/addenda or supporting evidence (dataflow diagram + proof of SCCs or equivalent).

Can you send the minimal set of artifacts (CSV of delta, dataflow diagram, and any signed subprocessor consents) so our procurement/legal can close the loop? We prefer PDFs and a small CSV for ingestion. Ideally we get this today or tomorrow as we have an internal go/no-go.

Thanks,
Susan

Head of Privacy Operations
Orion Health

Susan — thanks for the ping and the clear checklist. Looping in Neha (privacy) and Monica (legal) so we can provide the right artifacts.

Quick answers up front:
- Redwood does not permit onward transfers outside the EEA for customer data unless the customer (you) has granted export consent or the transfer is covered by contract (SCCs) and documented in the DPA amendment.
- The two new subprocessors (LogStream Inc. and MetricWave Ltd.) are both contracted on SCCs; MetricWave's processing is EU-only by contract.

We will provide:
1) vendor-roster-delta-20261110.csv (minimal roster CSV showing newly added vendors and processing category)
2) redwood-dataflow-orion-20261110.pdf (targeted dataflow showing where logs/metrics are stored and retention controls)
3) signed-onward-transfer-consent-ORH-20261111.pdf (template consent/ack now signed by the subprocessor for transfers we control)

Neha / Monica — can you confirm the SCC execution dates and add any short notes about DPIA status? I expect to send the package by EOD.

Best,
Aditya
Aditya Rao

Redwood Inference

Hi Susan / team — Neha here from Privacy. Short summary and artifacts attached.

Summary:
- LogStream Inc. (log retention) processes anonymized operational logs derived from telemetry. We enforce EU-only storage for customer data under the contract clause and have SCCs in place (signed 2026-10-21).
- MetricWave Ltd. (metrics aggregator) is contracted under SCCs signed 2026-10-28 and has an EU-hosting requirement in Schedule 2 (no onward transfer outside EEA without customer opt-in).
- DPIA: No full DPIA was required for these additions because the processing categories are standard operational telemetry and covered under our umbrella DPIA; however we have an addendum memo describing risk and mitigations (attached).

Attached: vendor-roster-delta-20261110.csv, redwood-dataflow-orion-20261110.pdf, subproc-dpia-addendum-20261111.pdf, signed-onward-transfer-consent-ORH-20261111.pdf
